### Screenshots

Refreshes the SwiftBar captures on [the plugin's page](https://mpm.run/bar-plugin/).

Each one is a real screenshot: a hosted runner installs SwiftBar from its pinned release, feeds it the menu `BarPluginRenderer` produces from `docs/outdated-sample.json`, opens the menu with a real mouse event and photographs the window. Only the package data is held still, and the crop stops above SwiftBar's own rows so its *Updated N Seconds Ago* clock cannot rewrite every image on every run.

This PR is auto-generated by `.github/workflows/docs-screenshots.yaml`. Review it as a picture: anything unexpected in the frame is the finding.
